## Living Island (CR 20)

**XP** 307,200  
N Colossal plant (aquatic)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** blindsight 120 ft., low-light vision; Perception +24  


**Defense**


**AC** 36, touch 1, flat-footed 36 (-1 Dex, +35 natural, -8 size)  
**hp** 570 (30d8+330); regeneration 5 (fire)  
**Fort** +39 **Ref** +21 **Will** +22  
**Defensive Abilities** absorption; DR 15/—; Immune cold, plant traits; Resist electricity 20  


**Offense**


**Speed** 10 ft., swim 40 ft.  
**Melee** slam +35 (4d6+30), 4 roots +33 (2d8+20/19-20 plus grab)  
**Space** 100 ft.; **Reach** 100 ft. (200 ft. with roots)  
**Special Attacks** capsize, constrict (2d8+20), trample (4d6+30)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 51, **Dex** 8, **Con** 30, **Int** 2, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 6  
**Base Atk** +22; **CMB** +50; **CMD** 59 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Blind-Fight, Cleave, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Great Cleave, Improved Critical (roots), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Multiattack, Skill Focus (Perception, Swim), Weapon Focus (roots, slam), [Lightning Reflexes](../../rules/feats/lightning-reflexes.md), [Great Fortitude](../../rules/feats/great-fortitude.md), [Skill Focus (Swim)](../../rules/feats/skill-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Diehard and Endurance and Toughness are one feat, Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Lightning Reflexes, Great Fortitude, Skill Focus (Swim).*  
**Skills** Perception +24, Swim +55; Racial Modifiers +8 Swim  
**SQ** amphibious, blend, growth, icebreaker  


**Special Abilities**


**Absorption (Ex)** A living island has a massive body filled with redundant structures and designs, making it incredibly difficult to harm or affect it in any way. It gain a resistance bonus to all saving throws equal to its Constitution modifier.  

**Blend (Ex)** So long as a living island remains still, it blends in to its terrain and appears to be an island (or a small hill on land).
